text.id: Jam delapan lewat dua. Kurirnya pake jaket tanpa logo dan helm yang kacanya nggak dibuka. Dia nyodorin tanda terima. Tanda tangan gue jelek, kayak biasanya.
text.en: Two minutes past eight. The courier wears a jacket with no logo and a helmet with the visor down. He holds out a receipt. My signature is as ugly as ever.

text.id: HP Sekar masuk ke amplop cokelat. Amplopnya masuk ke tas. Motornya pergi.
text.en: Sekar's phone goes into a brown envelope. The envelope goes into a bag. The motorbike leaves.

text.id: Lampu belakangnya merah kecil di ujung gang, terus belok, terus nggak ada.
text.en: Its tail light is a small red dot at the end of the alley, then it turns, then it's gone.

text.id: Dinda nggak ngomong apa-apa malem itu.
text.en: Dinda doesn't say anything that night.

text.id: Paginya, akun cloud Sekar kosong. Foto, catatan, draf, semuanya. Halaman dasbor podcast-nya bilang "akun tidak ditemukan".
text.en: In the morning, Sekar's cloud account is empty. Photos, notes, drafts, all of it. Her podcast dashboard says "account not found".

text.id: Grup pendengarnya sepi. Nadia nulis "kak?" sekali lagi, tiga hari kemudian. Nggak ada yang bales.
text.en: The listener group goes quiet. Nadia writes "kak?" one more time, three days later. Nobody answers.

text.id: Seminggu kemudian, Ipda Yusuf nelpon. Laporannya ditutup. Orang dewasa, pergi atas kemauan sendiri. Dia minta maaf, dan kedengerannya dia beneran minta maaf.
text.en: A week later, Inspector Yusuf calls. The report is closed. An adult, left of her own accord. He apologizes, and he sounds like he means it.

text.id: Gue balik ke Bandung. Gue ngedit iklan asuransi. Kadang, jam lima pagi, gue kebangun dan nggak tahu kenapa.
text.en: I go back to Bandung. I edit insurance ads. Sometimes, at five in the morning, I wake up and don't know why.

summary.id: Raka menyerahkan HP Sekar ke kurir Didit. Semua yang Sekar simpan hilang dalam semalam, dan kasusnya ditutup.
summary.en: Raka gave Sekar's phone to Didit's courier. Everything Sekar had kept was gone overnight, and the case was closed.
